w:r.w:t: BookTrack is an offline-first Progressive Web App (PWA) designed for voracious readers who manage both physical and digital book collections. The app enables users to:
Read EPUB and PDF ebooks with progress tracking
Track and log physical books they've read (manual + barcode scanning)
Save quotes from books for later reference
Maintain full functionality without internet connectivity
Sync progress across sessions using local storage

This MVP prioritizes book tracking and physical book logging, with ebook reading as a complementary feature. The app works entirely offline using IndexedDB, making it ideal for users in low-signal environments like public transportation.
Transform how book lovers engage with both physical and digital libraries by providing a seamless, offline-capable tracking system that celebrates reading across all formats.
Offline-First: Works without internet; progress syncs locally
Universal Tracking: Unified tracking for ebooks and physical books
Low Friction: Manual entry + barcode scanning for easy logging
Quote Preservation: Capture meaningful passages for later reflection

As a regular commuter, I want to read ebooks offline so I can read during my 1-hour train ride with spotty signal.
Acceptance: Can upload EPUB/PDF, read for 45 min with no internet, and see progress saved when I reconnect
As a voracious reader, I want to log all my physical books in one place so I can see my reading stats and remember which books I've finished.
Acceptance: Can add 50 physical books, search them, filter by status (reading, completed), and track progress
As a book lover, I want to quickly add a physical book via barcode scan so I don't have to manually type title and author.
Acceptance: Scan barcode → app auto-fills title, author, cover. Can edit if needed.
As a reader, I want to capture quotes from books so I can revisit them later and build a personal quote library.
Acceptance: Can save quote + page number from ebook. View all quotes filtered by book. Export list.
As a bookshelf curator, I want to see a photo of my physical book covers so it feels visual and personal (not just a list).
Acceptance: Can take photo of book cover. App extracts text/cover via OCR. Cover displays in book card.

Q: Can users sync data across devices?
A: Not in MVP. Data is stored locally in each browser. Future enhancement could add optional cloud backup.
Q: What happens if the user clears their browser data?
A: All books, quotes, and progress will be lost. We recommend users export/backup data, but this is not MVP priority.
Q: How do we handle large PDF files?
A: PDFs up to 100MB can be stored in IndexedDB. If the file exceeds storage quota, users will be notified.
Q: Can users highlight text in the ebook?
A: In MVP, only quote selection/saving is supported. Persistent highlights will be a future enhancement.
Q: Does barcode scanning require internet?
A: Barcode detection (ISO/scanning) is done locally (ZXing.js). If user wants to auto-fill metadata from Google Books API, internet is needed. Manual fallback always available.
Q: How long do reading sessions typically last?
A: MVP targets 15-45 min sessions. Auto-save every 30 seconds ensures no progress loss.
